_readme: Runtime configuration for the Ryde dispute pipeline. Edit this file, not the code.
confidence_threshold: below this value the Judge does not rule; the parties see the
neutral under-review message instead. Change it live during the demo to show the gate.
autonomous_cap_sgd: policy ESC-4. A remedy above this amount is prepared but never
issued autonomously -- it is withheld for a human, exactly like a low-confidence
ruling. Enforced in app/agents/judge.py, not asked of the model in a prompt.
dataset_pack: which corpus under data/packs/ the CLI reads disputes from. The pack
holds disputes/, ground-truth.json and pack.json; swapping corpora is a directory
copy, never a code change. Override for one run with --pack <name>.
llm.provider: mock by default, so the tests and a fresh checkout need no keys. Run the
real model with --llm tencent (CLI or server). llm.endpoint is the Tencent Cloud ADP chat
endpoint; llm.model is the label recorded on each ruling. The three ADP app keys never
go here: they live in .env (see .env.example) and .env is never committed.
llm.case_budget_seconds: total retry budget for one case; when it cannot cover the next
call or retry wait, the case is escalated for human review.
